steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to a pipeline with a runnable LLM node
Step 2 — Send Message A, clear the chat, send Message B (creates 2 distinct Run History entries)
Step 3 — Click the 'view run history' icon button; the Run History panel opens (replacing the Configuration form + embedded chat)
Step 4 — Verify the run history panel opened: execution entries (run-history-list-item rows) are present
Step 5 — Verify at least 2 execution entries are listed (conversation A + conversation B)
Step 6 — Click the non-selected (older) entry; verify it shows the message and response details for that execution
Verify no console errors across the full flow
